summary_bullets: Accepted same-branch, ancestor-preserved coder commits in lint-fix-loop when the pre-dispatch baseline is clean.
Added prefix-aware forbidden-path enforcement for committed coder deltas plus residual working-tree forbidden cleanup.
Updated lint-fix-loop, ship-pr, security, and linting docs/tests for the new applied-with-head-changed contract.
commit_message:
Accept safe coder commits in lint-fix-loop

Treat clean same-branch descendant commits from external CI fixers as applied fixes while preserving fail-closed handling for detached HEAD, branch switches, history rewrites, and dirty baselines. Enforce forbidden paths against committed deltas before returning success.
